newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower after 2 days of rises.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower after 2 days of rises.

text.p: Stocks succumbed to profit-taking on Thursday sharp rises in the past two sessions, dealers said.
Short-term investors booked profit after sharp rises in the past two sessions, a dealer of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi bourse 100-share index closed 11.23 points, or 0.69 percent, lower at 1,616.10 after rising to 1,632.48 in early trade.
Losers led gainers 136 to 132. PTCL fell 0.60 rupees to 30.65, HUBCO 0.25 to 38.50, ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 25.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.55 to 41.35 rupees. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
